tasks.title: Implement the event model, XState Harness and revision-safe persistence
tasks.outcome: The existing application runs the canonical conversation state machine with proposal/commit separation, six-dimension evidence contracts, revision invalidation, pause/resume and hard limits while preserving the frozen visual system and stable guest/privacy infrastructure.
done_when: `.loom/implementation/TASK-008-migration-inventory.md` maps every declared donor table, route, working-memory helper and regression test to its retained, migrated or retired Harness responsibility before schema/API edits begin.
XState v5 expresses every documented top-level and wave state; AI output cannot bypass guards or commit state directly.
Zod contracts implement Source revision, radar cells/deltas, wave mission, microbatch, insight, readiness and stale propagation without PersonaSnapshot/CoverageCell or scores.
Committed question batches, source edits, retries and refresh are idempotent and transactionally preserve exact revisions.

`open_wave` for core or accepted deep-dive kind accepts exactly 5-10 ID-free elicitation-unit proposals with target dimensions and 1-3 opening questions; the host persists immutable contiguous unit order and assigns every mission/unit/question/option id exactly once. `continue_wave` uses exact trusted pending unit ids and remains stable across refresh/reordered reads.

`propose_deep_dive` is recommendation-only; acceptance and the later `open_wave` use different proposal/provenance/idempotency identities, and rejection/retry/refresh cannot create a partial or duplicate wave.

`deriveRouteReadiness(snapshot)` deterministically derives every GateStatus and exact refs from one committed revision, including six-axis route distinctness, explicit design-question source, calibration skip semantics and active SafetyFlags; model-supplied statuses are rejected.

Every insight and ordinary-day calibration verdict creates a required exact calibration SourceVersion, including verdicts without text; duplicate delivery and injected write failures leave no partial source or propagation.

Every accepted model commit persists complete immutable GenerationProvenance and required artifact foreign keys in the same transaction; semantic correction uses append-and-`supersede_claim`, preserving old content/evidence/provenance; failed/expired/replayed proposals create no orphan or duplicate provenance.
